interest: Frank 1947 State Department talk of American racism and why the Crown Prince should study in England.
overview: Secret letter of February 17, 1947 advising that Crown Prince Akihito study with Elizabeth Gray Vining in Japan, then attend university in England rather than America.

people.name: Elizabeth Gray Vining
people.role: Tutor to the Japanese Crown Prince

people.name: Yosuke Matsuoka
people.role: Former Minister of Foreign Affairs of Japan (referenced as a former student at an American university)

people.name: Walter Gieseking
people.role: German pianist (referenced in connection with public controversy surrounding the 'Gieseking affair')

subfiles.about: Confidential commentary and policy guidance concerning whether the Japanese Crown Prince should be educated in the United States or England.
subfiles.summary: An unnamed official advises 'Bill' that the Crown Prince study two more years in Japan under Elizabeth Gray Vining, then attend an English university, citing American hostility, racism and Matsuoka's experience. The Secretary concurred.
subfiles.title: Personal and Secret Letter to 'Bill' on the Question of Educating the Japanese Crown Prince
